newsitem.title: FRANCE: France may add Giat to privatisation list - paper.
newsitem.headline: France may add Giat to privatisation list - paper.

text.p: The French government may add arms maker Giat Industries to the list of state companies to be privatised with a view to enabling it to take part in European defence alliances, the newspaper Figaro reported on Wednesday.
It said a Defence Ministry source said a move to put money-losing Giat and explosives manufacturer SNPE on the privatisation list was under consideration.
"The objective would be to allow them the possibility legally to take part in European structural alliances essential to their development," the ministry source was quoted as saying.

Giat is currently unable to create the joint munitions venture it had envisaged with Britain's Royal Ordnance, but the project could be revived if Giat were slated for privatisation, the newspaper said.
Such a move would also require legislative approval.
